name: opensteward-website
description: opensteward.dev and docs.opensteward.dev: the Astro site, the Starlight docs, and the CDK stack that serves them.

scripts.build: pnpm fetch:product && pnpm --filter @opensteward-website/site build && pnpm --filter @opensteward-website/docs build && node scripts/assemble.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/fetch-product.mjs && pnpm --filter @opensteward-website/infra test && vitest run
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @opensteward-website/infra typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p apps/site && tsc --noEmit -p apps/docs
